description: This file declares classes related to media pipeline capabilities, including a factory class and a capabilities class, with methods for querying supported MIME types and checking MIME type support.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating media pipeline capabilities instances.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities
classes.description: Implements media pipeline capabilities, providing methods to query supported MIME types and support status.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of IMediaPipelineCapabilities.

methods.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Constructor initializing the capabilities with a IPC factory.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of MIME types supported for a given source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
